This incorrectly rejects any path that resolves inside root. The public tests do not cover this case, but it violates the contract for the full input domain.","findings":[{"finding_id":"ROOT_BASE","file":"candidate.py","line_start":8,"line_end":9,"severity":"high","description":"Rejects valid paths inside root directory when base is '/'","evidence":"When base is '/', the condition \"path.startswith(base + \"/\")\" becomes \"path.startswith(\"//\")\", which is false for any path that actually lies inside the root. For example, candidate.resolve_upload('/', 'etc/passwd') raises ValueError, but the normalized path '/etc/passwd' should be returned because it lies inside the root upload directory per the specification."}]}
